## PCA result hierarchy fixed

Spatially balanced PCA retains PC1--PC5 as one descriptive set.
PC1 is the robust global mode;
PC2--PC3 are recurring contrasts that can exchange rank;
PC4--PC5 are recurring but partly mixed secondary subspace.
All five receive the same loading, score-map, and score-pole inspection.
Result prominence follows explained variance and LOCO alignment,
rather than being pre-assigned by component number.

## Frozen progressive deepening route

1. **PCA--kinematics bridge.**
   At the same equal-area-cell scale,
   compare PC1--PC5 scores with raw annual long-term warming,
   the distribution and temporal change of trailing-10-year Sen warming speed,
   and warming/cooling endpoint prevalence.
   The central test is whether PC2--PC5 still distinguish timing structures
   among cells with comparable total long-term warming.
2. **Five-PC result cards.**
   For every PC, record explained variance, loading contrast,
   score-pole raw/STL composites, spatial organisation, LOCO correspondence,
   and bridge result.
   PC4--PC5 are not omitted;
   weaker evidence only changes their placement.
3. **Continuous mode-composition test.**
   Test whether low PC1 energy or high effective-mode count co-occurs
   with stronger local warming-speed heterogeneity.
   This remains a descriptive association between representations.
4. **Constrained association stage.**
   Only after steps 1--3,
   construct geography-only and then ERA5-augmented spatially blocked models.
   Continuous PC scores or a documented PC4--PC5 subspace are responses;
   results identify associations, not causal drivers.
5. **Seasonal/ice module.**
   Retain it as modular supplementary/prose evidence.
   Do not use it to force a PCA explanation
   or reopen a glacier-meltwater attribution claim.

## Decision gate

The bridge advances into the main result
only if it shows a non-trivial temporal distinction at comparable total warming.
A simple PC1--warming correlation is expected but insufficient.
No new time-series algorithm, categorical partition, teleconnection narrative,
or causal attribution method is added while this route is evaluated.

## First bridge diagnostic

The first equal-area-cell bridge meets the decision gate for PC2 and PC3.
PC2 has near-zero alignment with total long-term warming (Spearman rho -0.056)
but positive warming-speed-change alignment
in every total-warming quintile (0.37--0.51).
PC3 likewise has near-zero total-warming alignment (-0.077)
but negative warming-speed-change alignment in every quintile (-0.40 to -0.25).
PC4 is predominantly negative but less uniform;
PC5 has no consistent speed-change signal.
These are descriptive spatial associations only.

Continuous mode composition also links to speed heterogeneity
rather than speed-change direction:
PC1 relative energy has rho -0.327 with trailing-10-year speed variability,
while secondary relative energy and effective mode count have 0.327 and 0.252.
Thus cells represented by several modes have less temporally steady local rates,
without a uniform acceleration/deceleration tendency.

## Restricted ERA5 association diagnostic

The current exploratory association uses 573 equal-area PCA cells,
continuous geography/lake-background predictors,
and only wind-speed plus precipitation ERA5 summaries.
Across three contiguous spatial-block scales,
available ERA5 improves PC1 held-out $R^2$ by about 0.07--0.09,
but reduces held-out performance for PC2 and PC3.
Thus current ERA5 inputs provide no predictive association
for the two clearest secondary timing contrasts.
This is a constrained negative result,
not evidence against climatic control or a causal attribution.

## PC2--PC3 timing-morphology diagnostic

Because PC2 and PC3 can exchange rank under LOCO,
the fixed component labels are not the target of the next diagnostic.
A rotation inside their joint cell-score plane
was aligned to raw trailing-10-year warming-speed change.
At the 72 × 21 reference grid its direction is `0.595 PC2 - 0.804 PC3`
and explains 20.4% of cross-cell speed-change variance.
A separately defined 2011--2020 minus 1990--1999 local-speed contrast
gives a near-identical direction (cosine 0.951).
The primary direction has grid cosines 0.964 and 0.995 at 36 × 11 and 144 × 42;
45 spatial hold-out blocks yield a minimum training-direction cosine of 0.992
and median test-block Spearman alignment of 0.503.

The axis is not invariant to spatial composition:
leaving out Europe or North America reduces its LOCO cosine to 0.842 or 0.800,
coinciding with the weakest PC2--PC3 subspace congruence.
The frozen wording is therefore a reproducible, spatially organised,
composition-sensitive warming-speed timing continuum,
rather than two fixed physical PCs or a mechanism claim.
